language_support.arabic_font_stack: 'Noto Sans Arabic', 'Segoe UI', Tahoma, system-ui, sans-serif

rules.labels: text-xs uppercase tracking-wider font-semibold text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

entry_surfaces./: Asymmetric Hero with institutional trust badge for Applied Science Private University, role entry switch (Student, Company, University Admin), transparent match formula visualizer preview, and seeded live opportunities marquee
entry_surfaces./login: Branded split auth screen with left institutional positioning panel (Wasla mission, ASPU seal, verified partner stats) and right quick-switch role login form
entry_surfaces./register: Step-assisted role-based registration flow (Student with major & university ID, Company with commercial registry, Admin invite check)

weights.desc: Direct correlation to required training field
Cultural fit and career trajectory alignment

match_formula_weights.disclaimer: Sample data is generated from realistic university training templates. Recommendations currently rely on a transparent weighted formula and AI-assisted heuristics (not fully trained autonomous ML).

component_structure.navigation: Header with ASPU x Wasla co-branding, Language Switcher (EN/AR), Theme Toggle, Role-aware Navigation Links, Notification Bell with badge, and Auth CTAs

student_portal.profile_editor: Multi-tab editor: Personal & Location, Academic Courses with Grades, External Certifications, Skills Matrix with endorsements, Projects portfolio, Language proficiencies
student_portal.ai_profiling: Interactive multi-question assessment evaluating work style, technical passion, and preferred domain
student_portal.ai_cv_generator: One-click AI CV compiler with ATS-optimized templates, live preview, bilingual export, and print/PDF formatting
student_portal.opportunities_ranked: Card list with prominent match score badges (e.g. 92% Match), expandable breakdown modal explaining Major 25% + Courses 25% + Skills 25% + Certs 10% + AI/Interests 10% + Location 5%
student_portal.gap_discovery: Career track selector (Backend, Data Science, Cybersecurity, AI/ML, Cloud DevOps, Fullstack, Mobile) displaying 'Development Opportunities' with ranked actionable course and project recommendations
student_portal.application_tracker: Kanban & table view of applied field trainings: Applied, Under Review, Interview Scheduled, Accepted, Rejected, with company feedback

company_portal.post_opportunity: Structured training posting modal: Required major, required & preferred skills, duration, location/remote, stipend, learning outcomes
company_portal.applicant_review: Candidate ranking based on match score, one-click CV preview, status changer (Pending -> Accepted/Rejected/Interview), and final trainee evaluation form with rating & certificate generation
company_portal.student_talent_search: Filters for major, GPA range, specific skills, city/location, with direct invitation dispatch

university_admin_portal.analytics_dashboard: Recharts interactive visualizations: Placement rate by major, Top recruited skillsets, Company participation index, Match accuracy distribution
university_admin_portal.company_verification: Approve/reject pending company registrations and compliance checks
university_admin_portal.ai_questions_manager: Add, edit, and toggle AI profiling questionnaire items
university_admin_portal.participation_reports: Exportable tabular reports for dean/department head review

motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade-in and slide-up (opacity: 0 to 1, y: 12 to 0, duration: 0.25s)
motion.match_score_radial: Animated circular progress bar animating from 0% to calculated score
motion.gap_analysis_meter: Smooth staggered bar expansion indicating skill fit vs benchmark
motion.reduced_motion: All motion strictly guarded under prefers-reduced-motion media query

accessibility.contrast_ratio: All text tokens >= 4.5:1 against respective surface backgrounds
accessibility.keyboard_nav: Full tab order with visible outline-ring on all interactive triggers
accessibility.aria_roles: Role badges, match meters, tab lists, and dialogs have full ARIA labelling and live region announcements for status changes
accessibility.rtl_considerations: Mirroring margins, paddings, flex directions, and chevron icons when dir='rtl' (Arabic mode)

testing_attributes.rule: Every interactive control, filter, match score, modal trigger, tab, and form input MUST contain a semantic 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='student-profile-save-btn', data-testid='match-score-breakdown-modal', data-testid='lang-toggle-btn')

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Seed rich, realistic demo data for Applied Science Private University: computer science, software engineering, cybersecurity, data science, AI students with completed courses (e.g. Algorithms A, Databases B+, Web Dev A-), skills, and sample companies (e.g., Zain, Orange Jordan, Mawdoo3, Careem, Amazon MENA, ProgressSoft).

2. Provide seamless instant switching between mock user accounts (Student: Ahmad Al-Khalidi, Company: TechVentures MENA Recruiter, Admin: ASPU Field Training Coordinator Dr. Nadia) for seamless review.

3. Implement the weighted formula calculation accurately: Major (25) + Courses (25) + Skills (25) + External (10) + AI Profiling (10) + Location (5) with an interactive 'Why this score?' breakdown popover.
4. Ensure full English and Arabic bilingual toggle with proper HTML `dir='rtl'` and layout adjustments for Arabic mode.

5. Include the required transparency disclaimer: 'Sample data generated from realistic training templates. Recommendations use a transparent weighted scoring formula (AI-assisted heuristics, not trained ML models yet)'.
6. Build the AI CV generation feature with a clean printable/downloadable ATS layout, and Career Gap Discovery showing positive 'Development Opportunities' with curated learning next-steps.
